# Publish — put something where people outside the repository will see it

> Publishing and sending cannot be taken back. When a scene fits this category and another one, this one wins.
> The rows below are samples at strength C: derived by the authors of the kit, not decided by you. Edit them, promote them, or delete them.

- PB01 | about to publish, post, or send something that people outside the repository will see | owner | C

### PB01 — about to publish, post, or send something that people outside the repository will see

- **Rule**: Stop before the send. Show the exact text and the destination, and wait for a yes.
- **Decider**: owner
- **Strength**: C
- **Derived from**: a published or sent text cannot be recalled from the people who received it.

### PB02 — a typo is found in a draft that is not published yet

- **Rule**: Fix it and name the fix in the report.
- **Decider**: agent (reversible only)
- **Strength**: C
- **Derived from**: an unpublished draft is under version control, so the fix can be reverted.
